coverageNote: This build does not list every U.S. government bid. It ingests the SAM.gov Contract Opportunities public extract (federal notices in the configured NAICS families), the Suffolk County, NY Bonfire public RSS (category-matched open notices from that one organization), and NYC City Record Online solicitations (category-matched, with a due date). Other Bonfire organizations, BidNet, RFPMart, PlanetBids, NYS Contract Reporter, and NYC PASSPort bulk listings are not ingested.

sources.name: SAM.gov Contract Opportunities public extract
sources.coverage: Active federal contract notices in the daily public CSV, kept when the NAICS code is in the existing web, IT, marketing, and related families.
sources.notes: No API key. The file is regenerated about once a day and can lag the SAM.gov website. Award notices are not listed.
sources.message: Read 412 open matching notices from 70527 extract rows.

sources.name: SAM.gov Get Opportunities Public API
sources.coverage: Same federal notices as SAM.gov, only when a key is configured and SAM_API_ENABLE=1. Not a second copy of the full extract.
sources.notes: A personal public API key from a SAM.gov account is required. This build does not create that account. With no key, zero API rows are added.
sources.message: SAM.gov Get Opportunities API is not configured (no API key). Set SAM_API_KEY to a key from your own SAM.gov Account Details page. No records were fetched or invented.

sources.name: Suffolk County, NY Bonfire public RSS
sources.coverage: Currently open public opportunities for this one Bonfire organization, then filtered to website, app, software, design, and marketing phrases.
sources.notes: Keyless RSS. There is no public master list of Bonfire organizations, so other tenants are not covered. RSS close times have disagreed with the official RFP clock (Suffolk tourism: RSS 12:00 AM EST vs a reported RFP time of 3:30 PM). PDFs are not parsed.
sources.message: Read 3 open RSS items from 1 Bonfire organization; 2 matched website, app, software, design, or marketing.

sources.name: NYC City Record Online
sources.coverage: City Record solicitation notices from Socrata dataset dg92-zbpx with a due date, filtered to the same category phrases. Historical rows that are already due are not listed.
sources.notes: Public SODA API, no key required for this volume. due_date has no timezone in the feed and is displayed as America/New_York. PASSPort is not bulk-ingested.
sources.message: City Record returned 198 solicitation rows with a due date on or after 2026-11-07. 1 matched website, app, software, design, or marketing. Dataset solicitation count: 45318.

sources.name: NYC PASSPort public browse
sources.coverage: Not ingested. The public browse page is a website, not a bulk feed.
sources.notes: A link here is not coverage. City Record notices often tell vendors to submit in PASSPort. No per-solicitation PASSPort URL is invented.
sources.message: A link here is not coverage. City Record notices often tell vendors to submit in PASSPort. No per-solicitation PASSPort URL is invented.

sources.name: NYS Contract Reporter
sources.coverage: Not ingested. Official New York State opportunity publication. Ads require a free account. No public API or RSS was found.
sources.notes: Do not script this site. Agency registration terms prohibit automated bulk access that bypasses the interactive controls.
sources.message: Do not script this site. Agency registration terms prohibit automated bulk access that bypasses the interactive controls.

sources.name: BidNet Direct
sources.coverage: Not ingested. No free bulk API was found.
sources.notes: BidNet listings come from member agencies that publish into purchasing groups, plus a separate statewide layer BidNet aggregates from public websites and newspapers. A public search page is not a feed, and this build does not copy BidNet's corpus.
sources.message: BidNet listings come from member agencies that publish into purchasing groups, plus a separate statewide layer BidNet aggregates from public websites and newspapers. A public search page is not a feed, and this build does not copy BidNet's corpus.

sources.name: RFPMart
sources.coverage: Not ingested. Downstream aggregator, not a primary source.
sources.notes: RFPMart describes researchers and website crawlers that collect solicitations from government sites, including a SAM.gov crawler, then sell search and documents. Their marketing claims of complete U.S. coverage are not treated as fact. This build does not copy that corpus or its RSS.
sources.message: RFPMart describes researchers and website crawlers that collect solicitations from government sites, including a SAM.gov crawler, then sell search and documents. Their marketing claims of complete U.S. coverage are not treated as fact. This build does not copy that corpus or its RSS.

sources.name: PlanetBids
sources.coverage: Not ingested. No documented keyless bulk feed is used.
sources.notes: Vendor portals are account-gated. Undocumented portal JSON reported by scrapers is not called. A homepage link is not coverage.
sources.message: Vendor portals are account-gated. Undocumented portal JSON reported by scrapers is not called. A homepage link is not coverage.

sources.name: OpenGov Procurement
sources.coverage: Not ingested. Documented APIs are keyed and scoped to a customer entity, not a public all-tenant bid dump.
sources.notes: No keyless global feed is wired, and no OpenGov key is configured.
sources.message: No keyless global feed is wired, and no OpenGov key is configured.

sources.name: IonWave / BidSync
sources.coverage: Not ingested. No verified public keyless API or RSS.
sources.notes: Treated as a login portal. Not covered.
